title: Retirement plan enrollment administration - case-derived candidate
summary: A 2026 completed retirement-plan participant enrollment form establishes that this document type enters RTEC's HR records, but one case does not establish the complete enrollment, payroll, approval, transmission, or retention workflow.

claims.claim: RTEC HR received or retained a completed retirement-plan participant enrollment form in at least one 2026 case.
HR or payroll may have a repeatable process for reviewing, transmitting, implementing and retaining retirement-plan enrollment elections.

evidence.note: Inference from a single completed enrollment form; requires corroboration.

trigger: Employee submits or changes a retirement-plan enrollment/election.
controls: Do not infer payroll or provider transmission steps until corroborated.
unresolved_questions: Who reviews and transmits enrollment elections?
How are payroll deductions implemented and verified?
Where are completed forms retained and for how long?
What is the current enrollment/change deadline process?
automation_candidates: Once validated, track enrollment/change request receipt, review, payroll implementation and confirmation without storing sensitive election/beneficiary data in the Agent OS.

provenance.notes: No raw case content retained in GitHub.
